mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_EMPLOYEE.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO employee (employee_id, company_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, job_grade_id, hire_date, employment_status) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeNo}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentId}, #{jobGradeId}, #{hireDate}, #{employmentStatus})

SELECT SQ_USER_ACCOUNT.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO user_account (user_account_id, company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, role_code, status_code, activated_at) VALUES (#{userAccountId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{roleCode}, #{statusCode}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'ACTIVE' THEN END)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN user_account a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.company_id = e.company_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.employment_status = 'ST_SERVING' AND a.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT branch_id FROM employee WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employment_status = 'ST_SERVING' ORDER BY d.sort_order, e.employee_name, e.employee_id
